description: This file contains implementation of image convolution functions, including horizontal and vertical convolution routines, filter setup, and SIMD optimizations for the skia graphics library. It defines classes and functions for applying convolution filters to image data, with support for different CPU architectures.

classes.name: ConvolutionFilter1D
classes.description: Represents a 1D convolution filter with methods to add filters and retrieve filter data.

classes.name: CircularRowBuffer
classes.description: Manages a circular buffer of image rows for convolution processing.

methods.name: ClampTo8
methods.description: Clamps an integer value to the 0-255 range as an unsigned char.

methods.name: BringBackTo8
methods.description: Converts accumulated filter result back to 8-bit value, optionally taking absolute value.

methods.name: ConvolveHorizontally
methods.description: Performs horizontal convolution on a single image row.

methods.name: ConvolveVertically
methods.description: Performs vertical convolution to produce one output row.

methods.name: BGRAConvolve2D
methods.description: Performs 2D convolution on BGRA image data with optional SIMD acceleration.

methods.name: SingleChannelConvolveX1D
methods.description: Applies 1D convolution along the X axis for a single image channel.

methods.name: SingleChannelConvolveY1D
methods.description: Applies 1D convolution along the Y axis for a single image channel.

methods.name: SetUpGaussianConvolutionKernel
methods.description: Creates a Gaussian or derivative kernel for convolution.
